_doc: Game-wide tuning numbers. See docs/design/combat.md (veterancy) and docs/design/commander.md (ranks).
_crush_doc: Crushing (P3-07): a moving tank deals this percent of a max hp per second to enemies it drives into (touching, ahead of it). The damage matrix's 'crush' row says who can be crushed.
_fund_doc: UAE sovereign fund (P3-02b): every interval_s, a player of this faction earns percent of their unspent credits, at most cap per payment (doubled by the cap_doubled_by power).
_interop_doc: EU interoperability (P3-12c): a unit of this faction with at least min_types different unit types of its own side within radius_cm (itself included) reloads reload_percent faster; doubled by the doubled_by power.
_start_kit_doc: Skirmish starting units: [id pattern ({f} = faction id), dx_m, dy_m] from the start position. dx is mirrored for starts on the east half of the map.
